headline: Approved routine payroll and retirement actions, accepted two medical panel results, and tabled an ADR application until September.
summary: The board accepted July minutes, warrants, payroll, new members, retirement applications, withdrawals/transfers, and buybacks. It agreed to keep using the current investment policy, named Malden the lead plaintiff in security litigation with Intuit, and accepted medical panel results for James Connolly and Stephen Prince to send to PERAC. The board tabled the Lisa Hammersley ADR application because the physician's application was incomplete, and it discussed the director's salary without voting.
decisions: Accepted the July Board Meeting Minutes, August Expense Warrant, July Retiree Payroll and Staff Payroll Warrant, and July Cash Books & Cash Reconciliation, 4-0.
Accepted the list of new members, 4-0.
Accepted the Retirement Applications, Adjustments, and Survivor Benefits, 4-0.
Accepted the Buybacks, Makeups and Military Purchases item, 4-0.
Accepted liability for 5 months of service for Patricia Tramondozzi's transfer to MTRS, 4-0.
Decided to keep following the current CB Investment Policies until further discussion or changes are needed, 4-0.
Made Malden the lead on the Security Litigation with Intuit, 5-0.
Accepted the James Connolly Medical Panel Results and agreed to submit them to PERAC, all present in favor.
Accepted the Stephen Prince Medical Panel Results and agreed to submit them to PERAC, all present in favor.
Tabled the Lisa Hammersley ADR Application until the September meeting because the physician's application was incomplete.
